_meta.what: Append-only register of large, documented disagreements between IGRM salience ranks and independent comparator ranks. A row is a place to inspect, not evidence that either measure is right.
_meta.policy: Rows are never silently removed. Corrections retain the original id and add a dated correction note. Ranks are within each source's stated sample; raw licensed comparator values are never redistributed.
_meta.units: Percentile ranks and absolute percentile-rank gaps. Comparator samples differ by register family and are stated on every row.
_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). India Geopolitical Risk Monitor. https://igrm.in/
